import sys

def main():
    str_input = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    
    res = 0
    i = 0
    while i < len(str_input):
        j = i
        while j < len(str_input) and str_input[j] == str_input[i]:
            j += 1
        count = j - i
        if count > 1 and count % 2 == 0:
            res += 1
        i = j
    
    print(res)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
